instruction: Apply VS Code's find and replace function to fix the spelling of 'programing' to 'programming' throughout the entire document.

She has extensive experience in programing languages like Python and Java.
The company is looking for someone with strong programing abilities.
Good programing practices include writing clean and maintainable code.
The conference will feature sessions on modern programing techniques."""
with open('/home/user/Desktop/vscode_replace_text.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(text)
